common_findings: N1,N3,J2 give F06 a modest advantage; N2,J1 tie. All medium confidence. E047 more tightly separates valid actual consent from operative control over the recognition of refusal; F06 develops preparation, mandate-sensitive discretion and repair. No central conditional inference is shown false. Priority remains unestablished.

remaining_issues.E047: Explicit referral promises make the central case clear; less explicit claims of submission and mixed readiness delays need independent interpretation. Later informed ratification can remove a personal remedy while the historical procedure still retained discretion. Do not infer invalid actual consent.
remaining_issues.F06: A genuinely protected practical reservation must be established independently; ambiguity or temporary status alone is insufficient. Proportionate preparation under competing costs, the extra weight of a breach-specific repair reason beyond continuing compliance, and explicit retrospective ratification remain open.

coordinator_text_check: F06 section8 distinguishes preserving services from restoring reserved authority, and allows independently justified later authorization to end the reservation. Mere continuation cannot establish earlier compliance. A separate account of retrospective ratification is not supplied; do not describe all past moral questions as settled.
decision: Three preferences and two ties support a modest F06 advantage, not automatic selection or rejection of E047. Neutral and profile ties remain visible.
